question: Which of the following regarding the 2023 Intercontinental Cup final is correct?

options.text: Held in Guwahati; India beat Lebanon
Held in Bhubaneswar; India beat Lebanon
Held in Imphal; India beat Lebanon
Held in Ahmedabad; India beat Lebanon

solution:
The correct answer is __**Held in Bhubaneswar; India beat Lebanon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2023 Intercontinental Cup Final:** The **2023 Intercontinental Cup Final** was held in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**. The Kalinga Stadium served as the venue for the event.
 
• **India vs Lebanon Match:** In the final match, the **Indian national football team defeated Lebanon** with a scoreline of **2-0**. This victory marked a significant achievement for the Indian team.
 
• **Indian Team's Performance:** The Indian team showcased exceptional performance during the tournament, particularly in the final. Goals were scored by **Sunil Chhetri** and **Lallianzuala Chhangte**, leading India to a well-deserved victory.
 
• **Venue Significance:** The Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar is known for hosting various national and international sports events, including football and hockey. It has state-of-the-art facilities that make it a preferred venue for such tournaments.
 
• **Lebanon's Journey:** The Lebanese team also performed admirably throughout the tournament, reaching the final. However, they were unable to overcome India's strong defensive and offensive gameplay in the deciding match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Intercontinental Cup:**

 
 
• The **Intercontinental Cup** is an international football tournament organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**. It provides a platform for the Indian football team to compete against teams from different continents.
 
• The tournament aims to enhance the competitiveness of Indian football and prepare the team for larger tournaments such as the **AFC Asian Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Kalinga Stadium:**
 
 
• Located in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, the Kalinga Stadium is a premier sports complex that has hosted numerous international events, including **hockey world cups** and football tournaments.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately **15,000** and is equipped with modern facilities like floodlights, a well-maintained pitch, and training areas.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football's Progress:**
 
 
• The Indian football team, under the guidance of coach **Igor Štimac**, has shown consistent improvement in recent years.
 
• The team's captain, **Sunil Chhetri**, is one of the most celebrated footballers in India and has been a pivotal figure in India's success in international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Lebanon's Football Team:**
 
 
• The Lebanese football team is a competitive side in the Asian football circuit. They have participated in several tournaments and have a growing football culture in their country.
 
• Despite their loss in the final, the team's performance in the 2023 Intercontinental Cup was commendable.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Achievements in the Intercontinental Cup:** India has previously won the Intercontinental Cup in **2018**, defeating Kenya in the final. The 2023 victory marks another milestone in India's football history.
 
• **Sunil Chhetri's Contribution:** As one of the leading goal-scorers in international football, **Sunil Chhetri** continues to be a vital player for the Indian team, inspiring young players across the country.
 
• **Odisha as a Sports Hub:** Odisha has emerged as a major hub for sports in India, hosting various events and investing in sports infrastructure. The state government has been proactive in promoting sports at the grassroots and professional levels.
